def forward(pos,grip=1):
 o=r.observe(False);B=frame(o);p=B[:3,:3].T@(np.array(pos)-B[:3,3]);q0=np.array(o['proprio']['arm_pos'])
 def f(v):
  q=np.array([v[0],v[1],np.pi,v[2],0,v[3],v[4]]);T=fk(q)
  # gripper forward lies horizontally, local y points up; yaw free
  return np.r_[5*(T[:3,:3]@EE+T[:3,3]-p),3*(T[:3,:3][:,1]-[0,0,1]),3*T[2,2]]
 # choose elbow folded above, seeds try both elbow bends
 candidates=[]
 for seed in [q0[[0,1,3,5,6]],np.array([-.5,.4,-2.,.5,1.57]),np.array([-.5,1.,-1.,.5,1.57])]:
  res=least_squares(f,seed,bounds=([-50,-2.24,-2.57,-2.09,-50],[50,2.24,2.57,2.09,50]),max_nfev=300);candidates.append(res)
 res=min(candidates,key=lambda z:np.linalg.norm(f(z.x)))
 v=res.x;q=np.array([v[0],v[1],np.pi,v[2],0,v[3],v[4]])
 print('forwardIK',np.round(q,3),'err',np.round(f(v),4),flush=True)
 return move_q(q,grip,max_steps=150)

def smooth_ik(pos,R,q):
 lo=np.array([-100,-2.24,-100,-2.57,-100,-2.09,-100]);hi=-lo
 def f(a):
  T=fk(a);return np.r_[8*(T[:3,:3]@EE+T[:3,3]-pos),2*Rotation.from_matrix(R.T@T[:3,:3]).as_rotvec(),.02*(a-q)]
 res=least_squares(f,np.clip(q,lo+1e-6,hi-1e-6),bounds=(lo,hi),max_nfev=400)

def tilt(pos,phi=.08,angle=np.pi/4,grip=1):

def locate(o,expected,yaw):
 p=points(o,'robot_wrist');im=o['images']['robot_wrist'].astype(float)
 m=(im[:,:,0]>55)&(im[:,:,0]>im[:,:,1]*1.3)&(im[:,:,1]>im[:,:,2]*1.2)&(p[:,:,2]>.023)&(p[:,:,2]<.038)

 for i in range(1,n+1):
  ps=p[labs==i]
  if len(ps)<150:continue

 side=o['proprio']['base_pose'][1]
 for i,(xy,yaw,pick,cup,drop_side,bottom) in enumerate(RODS[:count]):
  o=r.observe(False)
  if o['done']:print('DONE',o['reason']);return o
  # First retract along the clear aisle, then align the arm above the next rod.
  if i:

  nominal=np.array([0,1.5,np.pi,-1.6,0,-.2,np.pi])
